summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a material fact: the local placement of dematerialized bearer bonds under an existing registered line of credit. Series BG bonds (ticker BSTDBG0125) were issued for Ch$ 16,200,000,000 (approx. $18.5M) maturing July 1, 2032, at an average rate of 6.10%. This is an ordinary debt offering, not a special situation. Routine capital market activity falls outside the scope of event-driven special situations.
